traits.name: Retaliatory Scratch
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger A creature within 10 feet makes a melee Strike against the plague giant Effect The plague giant makes a claw Strike against the triggering creature.

traits.name: Atrophic Plague
traits.text: (disease, divine, necromancy); Saving Throw DC 34 Fortitude. Stage 1 enfeebled 2 and fatigued (1 day) Stage 2 enfeebled 3 and fatigued (1 day) Stage 3 enfeebled 4 and fatigued (1 day)

traits.name: Hurl Corpse
traits.text: ⬻ The plague giant picks up a dead or dying creature within reach and flings it at a foe. The giant makes a rock Strike, using the body instead of a rock. If the body is a corpse, on a hit it explodes in a cloud of thick gray vapor, exposing all creatures in a 10-foot burst to atrophic plague. If the body is a dying creature, on a hit its dying value increases by 1 (or 2 on a critical hit).

traits.name: Pustulant Flail
traits.text: A plague giant's flail is covered in pus, causing it to deal 3d6 (3d6) additional poison damage.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ flail +31 (disarm, magical, reach 15 feet, sweep, trip); Damage 2d6+14 (2d6+14) bludgeoning plus 3d6 (3d6) poison and atrophic plague

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ claw +30 (agile, reach 10 feet); Damage 3d6+14 (3d6+14) slashing plus atrophic plague

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ rock +28 (brutal, range increment 120 feet); Damage 3d8+14 (3d8+14) bludgeoning
